comment: Apps the H9 Toolbox App Manager offers (dist/apps/). publish_catalog.py adds sizes, RAM, CRC and SHA-256 and copies each app to dist/apps/catalog/ as one .h9mod bundle. `name` is the main module (the menu label, 16 characters at most); `modules` lists every module the app installs, main first (default: just `name`). Names starting with '.' are hidden from the on-radio menu.

menu.name: MENU
menu.title: Module menu
menu.description: The on-radio list that opens when you hold Back. Installed automatically with the first app.

apps.name: BRICK BREAKER
apps.title: Brick Breaker
apps.description: Break 30 bricks with a bouncing ball. Menu moves the paddle left, Back moves it right, Up restarts after GAME OVER. Power-cycle to leave.

apps.name: APRS
apps.title: APRS
apps.description: Onboard APRS client: station list (opens with the stock Beacon List), station details, a map around your GPS position, messages (yours in green), and sending messages you type on the keypad to any station, or a status packet, from your callsign (experimental; stock firmware does the transmitting). Hold Menu to switch screens, Back to go back. Each screen loads into RAM when you open it.

apps.name: SAT PASS
apps.title: FM Satellite Passes
apps.description: The next five passes of FM repeater satellites (SO-50, ISS, AO-91, AO-27, PO-101, AO-123, LilacSat-2) over your GPS position, in the radio's time zone (UTC+0 by default): rise time, peak elevation, duration and time to go. Two pages, shown as tabs along the bottom (LIST, PLOT). On the list, Up / Down select a pass, Menu opens the plot and Back exits. PLOT draws the pass on a horizon plot (north up, rim = horizon, centre = overhead; rise green, set red, highest point yellow) with rise/set times and azimuths and the peak elevation; Up / Down step through the five listed passes and Menu or Back returns to the list. Uses the last fix saved on the chip until the GPS reports. Orbits are embedded when the app is built (elements of 2026-11-10); rebuild with fresh elements every week or two.

apps.name: GPS
apps.title: GPS Info
apps.description: Everything the radio's GPS receiver reports, on four pages: position (latitude/longitude, altitude, speed, course, satellites used, HDOP, Maidenhead grid), a sky plot of every satellite in view coloured by signal strength, a bar chart of signal-to-noise per satellite (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou), and UTC date/time (and local time from the radio's Time zone setting) with the last fix saved on the chip and sentence counts. Up/Down switch pages, Back exits. Read only.

apps.name: APRS MONITOR
apps.title: APRS Monitor (probe)
apps.description: First step to an onboard APRS client: reads packets and GPS straight from the APRS modem's serial ring and shows the last four stations heard. Also tests whether the ring keeps filling while an app runs. Receive only. Back returns to the menu.

apps.name: VFO PROBE
apps.title: VFO Probe (research)
apps.description: Research, read-only: shows where the stock radio keeps its tuned frequencies, as a step towards SAT PASS tuning VFO A/B itself. Set VFO A and B to two different frequencies (e.g. 145.800 and 435.000), hold Back and open it. Page 1 shows the receive/transmit fields found in the firmware; Menu scans RAM for frequency-like values (Up/Down scroll). Writes nothing. Back returns to the menu.
